verdict.rationale: Grafana's backing stores support unindexed, label-based querying (Loki indexes only label metadata, not the full log content, letting you filter/search on arbitrary fields like user_id or request_id at query time) and Tempo enables trace lookups by ID, plus Grafana Explore supports ad-hoc queries/drilldown without pre-built dashboards. However, none of the evidence explicitly discusses high-cardinality field grouping/filtering as a distinct capability, cardinality limits, or performance guarantees at scale, and this capability is largely delegated to the underlying data source rather than being a native Grafana feature. Missing for 10: explicit high-cardinality handling documentation, performance/scale guarantees for ungrouped ad-hoc queries, and independent validation of this specific use case.
